notes: Use-case summary: replace brittle keyword search w/ RAG-style semantic layer + reranker on product page and search results. Focus: lower cost-per-query during holiday spikes while preserving top-of-funnel relevance.
Traffic profile: baseline QPS ~400, seasonal peak ~8-10k QPS (holiday windows). Bursts often 4-6x baseline for 2-6 hour windows.
Indexing scale: planning 30-60M active SKUs (variants included). Retain 90 days of embedding deltas for freshness; full reindex monthly.
Latency targets: p50 < 80ms for embeddings lookup + rerank; p95 <= 250ms end-to-end for search queries under normal load.
Cost sensitivity: CFO requires modeled $/query at 1k/5k/10k QPS scenarios; target blended $0.0008-$0.002 per query for search+rerank.
Model preferences: open checkpoints (Llama2-family / Falcon variants) or Redwood-curated 70B opt for reranker; willing to accept quantized variants if accuracy within 3%.
Routing/fallback: primary hosted inference for latency; fallback to cheaper dedicated or smaller quantized model when capacity constrained. Need transparent QoS behavior.
Security notes: SSO mandatory, audit logs for admin actions, KMS for key separation, data residency: primary US, EU for EU customers.
Quote from Head of Search: "We need predictable economics — if we double traffic for Black Friday the bill can’t surprise finance."
